test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 18 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word(s) in the given sentence.

I have just come to know that the engine part__ ​is no longer produced and that I require it.__

options.text: is not produced by the company
that I require is no longer made.
which I needs is not available.
which I need has absent in the market

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence states that an engine part is no longer produced, and the speaker requires it.
 
• Option 2 correctly rephrases the sentence with grammatical clarity: "**that I require is no longer made.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I have just come to know that the engine part that I require is no longer made."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** This option unnecessarily adds "by the company," which changes the context of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** The phrase "which I needs" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4:** The phrase "has absent" is not a valid grammatical construction in English.
